import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    dp0 = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp1 = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    for ij in range(2 * n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(n + 1):
            j = ij - i
            if i < 0 or j < 0:
                continue
            if j > i:
                continue
            if i == n and j == n:
                continue
            if i == j:
                dp0[i][j] = max(1 + dp1[i + 1][j], dp0[i + 1][j])
            elif i == n:
                dp0[i][j] = max(1 + dp1[i][j + 1], dp0[i][j + 1])
            else:
                v1 = (dp0[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % MOD
                v2 = (1 + dp1[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % MOD
                v3 = (1 + dp0[i + 1][j] + dp1[i][j + 1]) % MOD
                dp0[i][j] = max(v1, v2, v3)
            
            if i == j:
                dp1[i][j] = dp0[i + 1][j]
            elif i == n:
                dp1[i][j] = dp0[i][j + 1]
            else:
                v1 = (dp0[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % MOD
                dp1[i][j] = v1
    
    print(dp0[0][0] % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
